title: Discovery of a lignan alkaloid, vitedoamine A, as an IKKbeta inhibitor for suppressing NF-kappaB mediated inflammatory responses and osteoclastogenesis in rheumatoid arthritis.
authors: Bai, Bingke; Zhou, Shuting; Guo, Yaoli; Wang, Hongrui; He, Xuhui; Huang, Baokang; Zheng, Chengjian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究木脂素生物碱vitedoamine A抑制IKKbeta及NF-kappaB通路治疗类风湿关节炎，分子对接仅涉及蛋白-小分子，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Phenylnaphthalene-type lignans have been recognized as the major anti-inflammatory constituents in V. negundo seeds, among which vitedoamine A (VA) was the first discovered lignan alkaloid bearing a gamma-lactam. However, the protective effects and specific target of VA against rheumatoid arthritis (RA) have not been explored yet. Herein, our study revealed that VA could inhibit the transcriptional activity of NF-kappaB, and suppress the production of NO and reduce the expressions of inflammatory cytokines (IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha) in several inflammatory cell models, mainly via inhibiting the phosphorylation of IKKalpha/beta and p65, and prevented the degradation of IkappaBalpha, thus restraining NF-kappaB activation. Meanwhile, VA considerably down-regulated the phosphorylation of IKKalpha/beta and p65, and inhibited the degradation of IkappaBalpha in RANKL-induced osteoclasts formation and differentiation, suggesting that VA may impede osteoclastogenesis and relieve joint damage in RA. Furthermore, VA interfered IKK/IkappaBalpha/NF-kappaB pathway and decreased the expressions of inflammatory cytokines in IL-1beta stimulated fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLSs), suggesting that VA possessed promising in vitro anti-RA capacity, probably by direct targeting IKKbeta and inhibiting its activity (IC(50) value: 39 muM). In addition, molecular docking displayed that VA could bind with residues Cys99 and Asp103 in IKKbeta via hydrogen bonds, thus preventing ATP from binding with IKKbeta to inhibit the activity of IKKbeta. Taken together, VA directly targets IKKbeta and significantly inhibits the IKK/IkappaBalpha/NF-kappaB pathway, thus inhibiting inflammatory responses in FLSs and mitigating joint damage related to osteoclastogenesis, displaying great potential in treating RA.
abstract_zh: 苯基萘型木脂素已被确认为V. negundo种子中的主要抗炎成分，其中vitedoamine A (VA)是首个被发现带有γ-内酰胺的木脂素生物碱。然而，VA对类风湿关节炎（RA）的保护作用及其特异性靶点尚未被探索。本研究中，我们发现VA能够抑制NF-kappaB的转录活性，并在多种炎症细胞模型中抑制NO的产生及降低炎症细胞因子（IL-1beta、IL-6和TNF-alpha）的表达，主要通过抑制IKKalpha/beta和p65的磷酸化，并阻止IkappaBalpha的降解，从而抑制NF-kappaB的激活。同时，VA显著下调RANKL诱导的破骨细胞形成和分化中IKKalpha/beta和p65的磷酸化，并抑制IkappaBalpha的降解，提示VA可能阻碍破骨细胞生成并缓解RA中的关节损伤。此外，VA干扰了IL-1beta刺激的成纤维样滑膜细胞（FLSs）中的IKK/IkappaBalpha/NF-kappaB通路，并降低炎症细胞因子的表达，表明VA具有前景的体外抗RA能力，可能通过直接靶向IKKbeta并抑制其活性（IC(50)值：39 μM）实现。另外，分子对接显示VA可通过氢键与IKKbeta中的Cys99和Asp103残基结合，从而阻止ATP与IKKbeta结合以抑制IKKbeta的活性。综上所述，VA直接靶向IKKbeta并显著抑制IKK/IkappaBalpha/NF-kappaB通路，从而抑制FLSs中的炎症反应并减轻与破骨细胞生成相关的关节损伤，显示出治疗RA的巨大潜力。
